summary: w154 research done; notes in the run directory's notes.md. The three scenarios are red at undefined steps (Givens for a turn-limit gate, a BLOCKED apply, and a formulate with no result; a Then for the proposal's status; the stub plans by agent, so apply and formulate cannot differ). Probes (run): a turn-limit round already keeps the status and exits 1 naming the round; a formulate or apply with no result already names the round. Defects: a gate round giving BLOCKED moves the proposal to awaiting-answer and writes its questions (D1); an apply round giving BLOCKED moves it to approved and on to formulated (D2). Round code is supervise_rounds.py Rounds.round, which never checks status. Open readings for the plan: whether a non-DONE gate writes its questions (r85 vs r86/r87); whether an integrate round's initiative goes back to proposed on failure (r84 vs r86); whether a proposal awaiting-answer under `work run <initiative>` exits with an error (D3). Probes are in .shop/scratch/w154-1-research/ (ignored by git).
